{{Quote|You'd probably like to shower me with ''kisses'', your royalness&hellip;but our sudden appearances ''has'' to have attracted every Imperial ship in the system!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter of Ord Mantell" />}}
The '''Jarnollen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jarnollen]].<ref name="Twitter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jarnollen system was originally created for the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars (comic strip)|newspaper comic strip]] ''[[The Bounty Hunter of Ord Mantell]]'', written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and penciled by [[Al Williamson]], which ran from [[February 9]] to [[April 19]], [[1981]].<ref name="The Bounty Hunter of Ord Mantell" /> It was first identified in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed the system in grid square L-7.<ref name="TEA" />
